question: Did the 48-cell factorial fail policy sensitivity because the three-act ever-activated predicate saturated, or because the sampled policy grammar contains no independently predictable variation in Scoreline and Afterimage exploitation intensity?
competingOptions: Policy vectors predict continuous mediator consumption on an independent policy root at the issue #421 R-squared threshold, so the binary ever-activated witness is the low-information surface.
Continuous mediator consumption is not predictably policy-sensitive under the frozen policy grammar, so the failing route requires a structurally different policy or mechanism grammar.

dataset.rows: Only post-v38-factorial-policy observations bound to the frozen factorial protocol.
dataset.unit: One policy index and factorial cell, aggregating the four common simulation seeds.
dataset.validation: Independent policy root 543 only; never used for model or hyperparameter selection.
dataset.scorelineTarget: log1p of the mean min(scorelineApplied, scorelineConsumed) count across the four seeds.
dataset.afterimageTarget: log1p of the mean min(afterimageApplied, afterimageConsumed) count across the four seeds.

features.policy: Every numeric sampled-policy leaf except the research421 experimental configuration, flattened in sorted path order.
features.interactions: Every policy leaf multiplied by every cell factor.
features.cellOnlyBaseline: The same selected model family fitted using only the five cell factors.

candidates: histogram gradient boosting with learning rate 0.05, 200 iterations, 15 leaves and L2 1
modelSelection.selection: For each route, choose the highest mean discovery R-squared under eight-fold GroupKFold by policy index. Exact ties prefer the earlier, simpler listed model.
modelSelection.fit: Refit the selected model on all discovery policy groups, then predict validation once.

estimands.mechanismActivationPrediction: Held-out validation R-squared of the selected full policy-plus-cell model.
estimands.policyIncrement: Full-model minus cell-only R-squared on validation, bootstrapped 5,000 times by resampling the 32 validation policy groups.
estimands.scope: Predictive policy sensitivity only. This audit does not identify an individual policy weight as causal, admit a detector, select content or establish RC acceptance.

successRule: A route has policy signal only when its one-shot held-out R-squared is at least 0.50 and the policy-increment bootstrap lower 95% bound is greater than zero. If both routes pass, conclude that the binary predicate saturated and preregister a continuous policy-sensitivity readout.
stopRule: If either route misses, bound the current sampled policy grammar as insufficient for that route and continue with a structurally different policy or mechanism grammar. Do not add scalar levels, tune the model on validation or try another unregistered model.
inconclusiveRule: A missing row, changed input hash, dependency drift, non-finite fit or incomplete policy-cell rectangle yields no content or grammar conclusion and requires a new protocol identity after repair.
